entries.title: Reply to a stuck-task alert
entries.body: The alert for a task that stopped moving now has a reply box, and your first mate answers you there. Its buttons are Nudge, Keep waiting and Discard: Nudge tells the task to carry on, and Keep waiting closes the alert and leaves the task as it is. Drop task is no longer on the alert; ask for it, or anything else, in a reply. The alert stays up until your first mate answers.

picture.alt: A stuck-task alert with Nudge, Keep waiting and Discard, and its thread with the captain's question and the first mate's answer
